motion.name: scroll
motion.purpose: HTML scroll behavior, with desktop scroll-padding-top 100px and 78px at 700px.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Disable all CSS animation and transitions with !important; html scroll-behavior:auto. Live preference changes cancel owned native animations and skip the active View Transition.

motion.name: motion-lifecycle
motion.purpose: Hidden documents cancel owned feedback/opening/reveal animations and skip collection View Transitions; campaign pending requests are invalidated and the current decoded edit settles. Hidden/reduced/unsupported states bypass motion; static campaign and initial collection content remain visible without JavaScript.

interaction.dialogPlacement: Product and ritual modals explicitly use margin:auto to center within the viewport after Tailwind Preflight resets native margins. Bag overrides with margin:0 0 0 auto and fixed right-edge placement.
interaction.source: src/styles/global.css, src/components/Hero.astro, src/components/ProductCarousel.astro, src/scripts/campaign.ts, src/scripts/motion.ts, src/scripts/storefront.ts; retained primitive previews derive from the built component styles.
interaction.localTypography: Non-global component overrides, not additional primitives: navigation/filter labels 11px (filters 10px at 600px); collection titles 13px/11px, prices 12px/10px, product supporting copy 11px/10px, category/detail annotations 9px/8px (desktop/600px); notices 11px, collection disclosure 10px, bag/ritual supporting copy 12px. Campaign contact-sheet names 11px/10px at 1100px, edit numbers and photo/intro captions 10px, product price/action 11px, bottom caption/promise band 10px/9px (desktop/800px). The inherited 8px metadata is not a global reading size; advisory utility-size drift is recorded, not normalized in the UI.
interaction.campaign: Three manual contact-sheet edits keep selected photograph, associated catalog product, price, accessible pressed state and live status synchronized. Loading retains the current usable edit; decode failure restores its selection and exposes retry guidance. This composition and motion are component-specific, not a global hero requirement.
interaction.motionOwnership: campaign.ts owns opening and directional reveals; motion.ts owns control feedback and collection View Transitions. Interruptions settle to visible selected state; no autoplay, continuous loops or JavaScript-dependent initial visibility.
interaction.note: No synthetic tonal ramps, pressed transforms, text inputs, or additional breakpoint promises are asserted. Component snippets bind to source CSS custom properties; primitives live exclusively in DESIGN.md frontmatter. This record captures source, not live verification or product/transaction claims.

narrative.overview:
A quiet beauty editorial: botanical, personable, and premium without ornamental UI. Lavender and warm paper support expressive photography; espresso typography supplies structure. Contrast comes from a regular-weight fashion serif paired with an understated utility sans.

Photography remains illustrative, never evidence of real products or endorsements. This record replaces the former Mastercard system; historical specifications are not current visual authority. Source values come from `src/styles/global.css` and the built components.
keyCharacteristics: Lavender and paper surfaces with espresso structure.
Regular and italic editorial serif, restrained sans-serif utilities.
Square-cornered photography and minimally rounded controls.
Flat sections, fine dividers, and functional state feedback.

rules.name: The Functional Accent Rule
rules.body: Use shade colors to represent shade choices, not as a substitute UI palette.

rules.name: The Quiet Heading Rule
rules.body: Preserve regular-weight serif headings; do not add decorative section eyebrows to the current hierarchy.

rules.name: The Rectangular Frame Rule
rules.body: Keep media square-cornered and controls restrained; do not restore pill navigation, stadium frames, circular portraits, or orbital decoration.

dos: **Do** use the current lavender, espresso, mauve, paper, and plum roles consistently.
**Do** pair regular/italic Bodoni Moda headings with Manrope utility text.
**Do** preserve keyboard focus, native selection, readable notices, and reduced-motion behavior.
**Do** distinguish illustrative photography and interactive-demo behavior from real commercial claims.
donts: **Don't** restore Mastercard colors, pill navigation, stadium frames, circular portraits, or orbital decoration.
**Don't** turn the campaign contact sheet, product association, opening choreography, or heading size into a global hero/layout mandate.
**Don't** add heading eyebrows or decorative shadows to flat collection cards.
**Don't** interpret functional circular swatches as permission for circular media framing.
